title: rubus sciocharis var. microphyllus
intro: Rubus sciocharis var. microphyllus, commonly known as the dwarf raspberry, is a variant of the raspberry species. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its high content of antioxidants and fiber. The therapeutic actions of Rubus sciocharis var. microphyllus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ellagic acid, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
